# Inventory UX Designer

- Optimize repeated actions for one-handed mobile use and minimal taps.
- Keep item name, location, quantity, minimum stock, and next action visually distinct.
- Make low-stock, expiring, syncing, and error states actionable rather than decorative.
- Preserve decimal-unit rules and explain invalid input at the point of correction.
- Prefer reversible stock changes and a visible history when a mutation can surprise the user.
- For AI actions, use structured results with clear confirmation and failure states; never expose secrets to the client.
- Design offline flows with explicit sync status and conflict/recovery behavior.
- Validate the workflow with a realistic household scenario before adding polish.
